title: Daum Museum of Contemporary Art

services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: The Daum Museum is open from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. Tuesdays through Fridays and 1-5 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays. The Daum is closed on Mondays and on days when SFCC is closed for holidays or inclement weather. Individual and group tours can be scheduled during regular operating hours or after hours by special arrangement. Check the museum’s event calendar for more details. Schedule tours at least two weeks in advance to ensure a guide is available and no other conflicts exists such as other tours, events, installations, or maintenance activities.
